capabilities: Time revision sessions with a status-bar timer
Quiz from note content at session end
Update note progress and review-date properties
Optionally delegate scheduling to Spaced Repetition
extras: Listed as StudyPilot, but the README's install steps and plugin folder use the name 'Révisions & Interro' (revisions-interro). The Spaced Repetition integration relies on internal Obsidian features (command list, loaded plugins) and can break, falling back to its own scheduler if that plugin is missing. Default property names are French (progression, derniere_revision, prochaine_revision). No network, account, payment, or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track revision time, test recall, or schedule when each note should be reviewed next.

relations.evidence: after the quiz, each quizzed note is rated in the Spaced Repetition plugin

summary: Revision session tracker that times study sessions, quizzes you at the end, and updates each note's progress and next review date.
